title: An Audio-Ultrasound Synchronized Database of Tongue Movement for Mandarin speech
why_promising: Primary synchronized Mandarin audio and ultrasound production from 54 participants (43 healthy and 11 dysarthric), with .lab/.TextGrid annotations. The authors state that normal-speaker MFA alignments underwent manual labeling checks for verification and patient speech was manually annotated for pronunciation; the public ScienceDB deposit is approximately 676 GB.
open_question: Enumerate the ScienceDB deposit at file level and determine whether the manually checked normal TextGrids and manually annotated patient files can be downloaded and isolated with stable file-level checksums/licensing. Admit only verified/manual annotation layers; do not treat unverified automatic alignment as core.
